page.layout: One printed page, title page. Top: a fleuron band across the full width. Then centred title lines in large capitals, centred imprint and motto lines in smaller type, a woodcut ornament in the middle, and the printer's imprint and date at the foot. No columns, no margin notes.

l.i: Sitis parati semper ad respondendum cuilibet petenti rationem ejus spei quae in vobis est, cum lenitate & reverentia, conscientiam habentes bonam, &c.

main_text.l: Hieronymus, in Epist. ad Rusticum monachum.

l.i: Veritas angulos non amat, nec quaerit susurrones.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament between the mottoes and the imprint, and a fleuron band at the head, not transcribed. Some letters in the mottoes are blurred (e.g. "Hicronymus", "Epist.", "dilectione") and read as printed on best reading. The Sᵗ. in the author line is read as printed "Sᵗ" (Sanctae Theologiae abbreviation).
